details: Tech Stack: Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, MySQL, Redis, Kafka
Collaborated with Ministry of Corporation to Develop this project with sole purpose to help
people affected by SAHARA scam. This is a real-time user details process and verify the details
with the different central government roles. Created microservices a rchitecture using Kafka for
bulk processing and Redis for session maintenance. Implement the payment module and Aadhar
seed communication for validating user details. Created applications based on government role
with technology Java(17), Spring Boot, and Angular(16).
